ideas.title: The Vulnerability of Critical Infrastructure to Cyber Threats
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent surge in cyberattacks on water systems and the measures being taken to prevent future attacks.
ideas.angle: The story would focus on the technical and policy aspects of critical infrastructure security.
questions: What are the most common types of cyberattacks on water systems?
What measures can be taken to prevent future attacks?
ideas.insight: This story is important because it highlights the vulnerability of critical infrastructure to cyber threats. By investigating the recent surge in cyberattacks on water systems, we can gain a better understanding of the technical and policy aspects of critical infrastructure security.

ideas.title: The Need for Greater Oversight and Accountability in the Non-Profit Sector
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent cases of fraud in non-profit organizations and the measures being taken to prevent future incidents.
ideas.angle: The story would focus on the policy and regulatory aspects of non-profit oversight.
questions: What are the most common types of fraud in non-profit organizations?
What measures can be taken to prevent future incidents?
ideas.insight: This story is important because it highlights the need for greater oversight and accountability in the non-profit sector. By investigating the recent cases of fraud in non-profit organizations, we can gain a better understanding of the policy and regulatory aspects of non-profit oversight.
